sections.heading: Build Your Future with a Leader in Testing, Compliance & Innovation
paragraphs: At ITC India Pvt. Ltd., we don’t just offer jobs—we build careers. As a NABL-accredited Testing & Calibration Laboratory headquartered in Sector 82, Mohali, Punjab, we are committed to delivering world-class testing, calibration, certification, and compliance solutions for industries across India and global markets. Recognized by the Bureau of Indian Standards (BIS) and trusted by leading manufacturers, importers, and innovators, we provide an exciting environment where talented individuals can learn, innovate, and grow.

Whether you are an experienced professional, a recent graduate, or a student looking for industrial training, ITC India Pvt. Ltd. offers opportunities to work with advanced technologies, experienced mentors, and real-world projects that make a meaningful impact.

sections.heading: Why Join ITC India Pvt. Ltd.?
paragraphs: Joining ITC India means becoming part of a team that values technical excellence, innovation, integrity, and continuous learning. Our employees work with state-of-the-art laboratory infrastructure and internationally recognized testing standards while collaborating with experienced engineers, quality professionals, and business leaders.

From Electrical Safety, EMC & EMI, Photometric, Battery, Environmental, UV, Solar, and IP Testing to Certification, Calibration, Business Development, and Quality Assurance, every department contributes to delivering reliable solutions that meet global regulatory requirements.

At ITC India, you’ll gain practical experience, develop technical expertise, enhance your professional skills, and build a rewarding long-term career in a collaborative and growth-oriented environment.
We regularly hire talented professionals across multiple departments, including:

sections.heading: Customer Support
paragraphs: At ITC India Pvt. Ltd., we are committed to developing the next generation of engineers and professionals through our 6-Month Industrial Training & Internship Program. Designed for Diploma, B.Tech, B.E., M.Tech, B.Sc., M.Sc., MBA, BBA, and other eligible students and fresh graduates, the program combines classroom knowledge with practical industrial experience.

Unlike conventional internships, our trainees actively participate in live projects and day-to-day laboratory operations under the guidance of experienced engineers and technical experts. This hands-on approach enables participants to understand industry practices, testing methodologies, quality systems, and regulatory compliance while working in a professional environment.

sections.heading: Business Development & Client Communication
paragraphs: Throughout the six-month program, interns develop technical knowledge, analytical thinking, communication skills, teamwork, and problem-solving abilities, making them industry-ready professionals.
bullets: Digital Marketing & Lead Generation (for marketing interns)

sections.heading: Mode: Full-Time, On-Site
paragraphs: Our workplace is built on collaboration, innovation, and continuous improvement. Employees and interns work in a modern laboratory environment equipped with advanced testing facilities while learning from experienced professionals. We encourage curiosity, reward performance, and provide opportunities for continuous professional development.

Whether you’re testing next-generation products, helping clients achieve regulatory compliance, or driving business growth through sales and marketing, you’ll be part of a team committed to quality and excellence.
Our recruitment process is simple, transparent, and designed to identify passionate individuals who are eager to learn and grow.
